review_notes: I read the whole file. I then grepped Mathlib for other definitions of the torsor classes and of the homeomorphisms smulConst/vaddConst, constSDiv/constVSub and pointReflection. The only definitions of these as `Homeomorph`s are in this file. The other hits are the base `Equiv` versions in Mathlib/Algebra/Torsor/Defs.lean and the affine, continuous-affine and isometry versions. Those are different structures, and the continuous affine equivalences build on the `Homeomorph` versions here. `IsTopologicalTorsor` and `IsTopologicalAddTorsor` have no competing class. The instances for G acting on itself, for products and for Pi types extend existing structures rather than duplicating them. I found no avoidable competing version of an existing concept.
